scientific limitations/integrity: The result is an exact analytic evaluation of the two limiting functions used in the source cooperation conditions. It does not claim new fixation criteria beyond those conditions, and the standard exponential-integral identities are classical; the new point assessed here is their application to these source-specific density-dependent threshold functions. Numerical evaluations are supplementary to the Riemann-sum proof.
title: Exponential-integral closed forms for completely mixed cooperation thresholds
